verdict.rationale: MotherDuck has a dedicated vendor docs page for dbt. It names dbt-duckdb as the adapter that lets dbt use DuckDB and MotherDuck, and says the only change needed is the `path:` setting [motherduck-docs-19, motherduck-docs-32]. The homepage also positions dbt workloads as a standard use case [motherduck-docs-50]. Missing for 10: the evidence shows little of the docs page beyond setup (materializations, auth in profiles, or project-structure guidance), the adapter is a shared DuckDB adapter rather than a MotherDuck-specific one, and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation of dbt runs against MotherDuck.
